value: antheridiogen-type signalling inferred in field gametophyte colonies: of 322 gametophytes in 3 colonies, males were 63%, females 20% and asexual 17% (G = 119.34, df = 2, P < 0.001); males clustered in Colonies 2 and 3 (spatial association with females, K(r) above the 95% simulation envelope) but not in Colony 1 (chi2 = 12.40, df = 11, P = 0.334), and females were not clustered in any colony
method: naturally occurring gametophyte colonies collected whole with their substrate, sex of each gametophyte scored and mapped, quadrat and Ripley K(r) spatial statistics compared with random simulations of sex expression
conditions: one study site, a tip-up mound at La Selva Biological Station, Costa Rica, collected January 2019; no antheridiogen bioassay was run, the effect is inferred from the spatial pattern; the abstract gives males as 62-68% in each colony and no hermaphrodites, the body gives 63% over all colonies; Colony 1 has 98 gametophytes in Table 1 but n = 95 in the text; Colony 2 had 75 and Colony 3 had 149; Colony 1 showed no significant dependence of male expression on females

source.authors: Harrington AD, Blake-Mahmud J, Watkins JE Jr
